topics.content:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS STUDIES
RELIGIOUS STUDIES
SECOND TERM
WEEK 3
PRIMARY 5
THEME - THE HOLY SPIRIT WORKING IN US
PREVIOUS LESSON - The Meaning of Pentecost | The Event of the Pentecost | The Spiritual Significance of the Pentecost Primary 5/Basic 5 Christian Religious Studies
TOPIC - THE HOLY SPIRIT
LEARNING AREA
1. Introduction
2. Who the Holy Spirit is?
3. The Holy Spirit is the third Person in God’s Head
4. The Significance of the Holy Spirit
5. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. explain who the Holy Spirit is.
2. identify the Holy spirit as the third Person in God’s head.
3. state the significance of the Holy Spirit.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can narrate the event of the pentecost.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of The Bible
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Holy Spirit is the the spirit person promised by Jesus Christ to his true believers to guide.
John 16 : 8
The work of the Holy Spirit is to convict us of our sin. And when He has come, He will convict the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
9 of sin, because they do not believe in Me.
WHO THE HOLY SPIRIT IS?
Holy Spirit is the the spirit person promised by Jesus Christ to his true believers to guide, comfort and counsel.
John 16:8 New King James Version (NKJV)
The work of the Holy Spirit is to convict us of our sin. And when He has come, He will convict the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
THE HOLY SPIRIT IS THE THIRD PERSON IN GOD’S HEAD
Reading Matthew 28:19
Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit…
The Holy Spirit is the third Person of the Trinity, mainly defined as:
“There is one God, eternally existent in three persons -
the Father,
the Son, and
the Holy Spirit.”
LESSON 2 - THE PURPOSE OF THE COMING OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
The purpose of the coming of the Holy Spirit is -
1. To fulfil the promise of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2. To comfort us.
3. To teaches us how to pray.
4. To inspire us.
5. To discerns the false spirits.
6. To reveals the will of God.
THE SIGNIFICANCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
The importance of the Holy Spirit are -
1. He guides us into Jesus truth.
2. He directs our steps.
3. He gives spiritual gifts.
4. He gives us power to preach the gospel.
5. He gives us the assurance of heave.
REVISION AND WEEK LESSON ASSESSMENT
As stated in performance objectives or lesson evaluation.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Asks pupils to narrate the event of the day of pentecost.
Pupil’s Activities - Summary the event of the day of pentecost.
3. Uses pupil’s responses to introduce and discuss who the Holy Spirit is.
Pupil’s Activities - Pay attention to the lesson introduction to participate actively the discussion.
4. Tells pupils about the Holy Spirit is the third person in God.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify and state the Holy Spirit is the third person in God.
5. Explains the significance of the Holy Spirit.
Pupil’s Activities - Analyze the significance of the Holy Spirit and explain.
6. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate actively in the summary of the lesson and write as instructed.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - The Meaning of Pentecost | The Event of the Pentecost | The Spiritual Significance of the Pentecost Primary 5/Basic 5 Christian Religious Studies
LESSON EVALUATION
Asks pupils to:
1. explain who the Holy Spirit is.
2. identify the Holy spirit as the third Person in God’s head.
3. state 5 significance of the Holy Spirit.
